shape.description: Analytic 2D SDF shape: circle or rounded box. Switching recompiles the effect variant.

scale.description: Uniform shape scale in the rotated field space; field units stay normalized to half canvas height.

rotation.description: Rigid in-plane rotation of the field; zero is identity.

tubeThickness.description: Interior band of the tube measured in signed distance; zero collapses to an anti-aliased filament.

secondaryBlend.description: Blend from mono tube color (0) to two-tone diffuse-lit coloring (1).

intensity.description: Master linear gain on tube and glow radiance; zero drives emitted color to zero while masks stay defined.

hotCoreIntensity.description: Hot gas-discharge core strength over the deepest tube interior.

glowIntensity.description: Outer glow gain shared by both exponential layers; zero removes the glow layer entirely.

glowRadius.description: Falloff scale of the two exponentials; zero is clamped to 0.001 exactly like the reference.

lightAngle.description: Directional light azimuth for the semicircular cross-section shading; the z component stays fixed at 0.7.

specularIntensity.description: Blinn-Phong highlight gain added after the diffuse shading.

specularSize.description: Highlight tightness; shininess is exp2(8 - 7*size) so 0 is broad and 1 is a tight spark.

cornerSmoothing.description: Mix between the raw centre SDF and the 5-tap corner-smoothed average; also widens the stencil radius.

flickerSpeed.description: Time multiplier feeding the three irrational-ratio flicker sines; zero freezes flicker.

flickerAmount.description: Dark-time amount; zero holds the lamp fully on at every time.

flowSpeed.description: Angular sweep speed of the rotating brightness band; zero parks the band.

flowAmount.description: How much the angular brightness band modulates the tube; zero disables flow entirely.

tubeColor.description: Primary tube color, sRGB hex; decoded to linear before the shading math.

secondaryColor.description: Shadow-side two-tone color, sRGB hex; decoded to linear.

glowColor.description: Outer glow color, sRGB hex; decoded to linear.
